commits.message: test(highlighter): generate the Rich golden at print's defaults, as the port prints it (rich-highlighter-nct1)

fix(highlighter): ReprHighlighter and the repr.* styles draw what Rich draws (rich-highlighter-nct1)

ReprHighlighter now carries Rich 15.0.0's patterns, compiled for the u flag
with Python's Unicode \w, \b and \d spelled out, and DEFAULT_STYLES carries
Rich's repr.* table. RegexHighlighter places each group by its match index
(the d flag) instead of searching the match for the group's text, which found
the first copy rather than the captured one.

test/core/repr-highlight.golden.json is Rich's own spans and truecolor bytes
for every string in Rich's highlight_tests plus the ticket's repro; its test
header carries the command that regenerates it. Kept divergence: JavaScript's
true/false/null/undefined are styled like True/False/None, for Pretty.

feat(template-bindings): style functions layer over a theme-name base style (rich-template-bindings-jtfa) (#308)

* feat(template-bindings): a style function layers over a fragment whose style is a theme name (rich-template-bindings-jtfa)

A RichText's stored style gains a third form, LayeredStyle: a Style added
over a name or definition the render has yet to resolve. applyStyleToFragment
lays the piped style over a string base instead of parsing it, so
`{{ .t | underline }}` on `new RichText("hi", {style: "my.heading"})` draws
the name from the render's theme with the pipe on top, and an undefined name
reaches onStyleError at render as a span name does.

RichText.style is now `TextStyle` (string | Style | LayeredStyle), which
makes a RichText no longer structurally assignable to PanelOptions; the
group.md example that relied on that to show a silent drop now says
TypeScript refuses the call.

* fix(template-bindings): review — Theme.resolve resolves a layered style; markup tag spans typed as strings; empty base takes the pipe (rich-template-bindings-jtfa)

* docs(template-bindings): link's byte-equivalence claim names the lifted-string case it holds for (rich-template-bindings-jtfa)
